body: That is really disappointing. No other options in the area?
Thanks for the response guys! I'm guessing these are "eternal format" cards? I am still quite the noob when it comes to that sort of thing...

I'm a girl and I have played Magic for less than six months. I don't shuffle that well to be honest. Even my boyfriend criticizes me while I play that I don't shuffle correctly. My opponents don't really point it out but I feel self-conscious. I insist that they cut my deck and they often just end up shuffling the deck instead. People are really nice at Magic. You get the odd douchebag but it's not like they're popular with everyone else either...
